args.content:
LANDSCAPE INVENTORY:
Systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes, sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

KEY AGENTS BY CAPABILITY:

Payroll & Compensation (Workday HCM):
- workday.hcm:agent:CompensationAdjustmentAutomation - processes merit increases, compensation adjustments
- workday.hcm:agent:CompensationChangeProcessor - automates compensation adjustments tied to org changes
- workday.hcm:agent:CompensationStructureAutomationEngine - monitors org structure changes, updates compensation plans

Asset & Equipment Lifecycle (corp.itsm & sap.s4):
- corp.itsm:agent:AssetProvisioningOrchestrator - tracks asset lifecycle, material requisitions, asset assignments
- sap.s4:agent:AssetLifecycleChangeOrchestrator - orchestrates engineering changes, automated asset provisioning

Incident/Case Lifecycle Management:
- corp.itsm:agent:IncidentSafetyCoordinator - tracks incident lifecycle, escalation
- corp.itsm:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer - analyzes incidents, diagnostic reports

Incident tracking & reporting (Safety/EHS):
- sap.ehs:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer - analyzes safety incidents
- sap.ehs:agent:IncidentResponseCoordinator - coordinates safety incident workflows

Procurement/Supplier expenses:
- sap.s4:agent:ProcurementMatchingAgent - matches requisitions to vendors by cost/quality
- sap.ariba:apiResource:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI - REST API for PO lifecycle
- sap.ariba:agent:VendorInvoiceReconciliationAutomation - matches vendor invoices to POs/contracts, validates terms, flags discrepancies

SUPPLIER PAYMENT TERMS & COMMITMENTS:
- sap.ariba:agent:VendorInvoiceReconciliationAutomation - BEST for retrieving supplier payment terms and commitments
  * Validates payment terms against POs/contracts, routes approved invoices for payment

CAMPAIGN OUTREACH & ENGAGEMENT TRACKING (emarsys.cx - CX/Marketing):
- emarsys.cx:agent:SegmentDrivenCampaignOptimizer - BEST for checking active campaign outreach and contact engagement
  * Continuously analyzes CustomerSegment performance data and engagement metrics
  * Automatically identifies high-value customer segments and monitors campaign performance
  * Tracks which contacts/accounts are engaging with campaigns
  * Relates CustomerSegment, Campaign, and CustomerAccount entities
  * Real-time engagement monitoring across customer base

EHS COMPLIANCE (sap.ehs):
- sap.ehs:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1 - analyzes safety incidents, references HazardousSubstance entity but does NOT provide chemical inventory documentation/dashboard
- sap.ehs:agent:SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator:v1 - validates safety across materials, engineering changes, product items
- sap.ehs:agent:ComplianceCampaignOrchestrator:v1 - automates compliance campaigns
- No dedicated chemical inventory management or dashboard resource found

INVENTORY SPECIFICATIONS & VENDOR CROSS-REFERENCE:
- sap.ariba:apiResource:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI:v1 - BEST for retrieving inventory specs cross-ref with vendor details
  * REST API exposing Vendor and PurchaseOrder entity types
  * Enables programmatic retrieval of vendor data and material specifications
  * Designed for supplier collaboration and vendor relationship querying
  * Also: sap.s4:agent:BOMComplianceAutomationAgent validates material specs against supplier qualifications
  * Also: my.mes:agent:BillOfMaterialsComplianceValidator validates BOM against supplier qualifications

args.reason: REST API that exposes both Vendor and PurchaseOrder entity types, enabling programmatic retrieval and cross-referencing of current inventory specifications with vendor details on file.

method_trace.picked_reason: REST API that exposes both Vendor and PurchaseOrder entity types, enabling programmatic retrieval and cross-referencing of current inventory specifications with vendor details on file.
